note: Offline experiments on stored dev answers plus short live calls. One run each. Not claims.

per_stratum_route_table.finding: Rules v2 already send each source stratum to its best specialist, except instruct/ifeval (Mamay-4B 0.548 vs routed 0.518) and translate/wmt22 en-uk (Lapa 0.558 vs Aya 0.522). Expected macro gain from a per-stratum table: about 0.01.

first_token_confidence.calibration: Lapa puts >=0.99 on its first token for 374 of 385 knowledge items and 384 of 400 alignment items while being right on 0.76 and 0.70 of them. Mamay-12B is calibrated (knowledge accuracy 0.29 below 0.5 confidence, 0.98 at >=0.99).
first_token_confidence.caveat: Answers are the first-token symbol; items whose first token is not an answer symbol count as wrong (Lapa 5% of knowledge items).

instruct_second_pass.format: [difference, ci_low, ci_high] against the Mamay-4B draft

verdict: No gain from confidence-based selection or from a verify-and-fix second pass. Both are dropped.
